business_summary.text: Blue Jet Healthcare is a CDMO and specialty pharma company making contrast media intermediates, pharma intermediates/APIs and high-intensity sweeteners.

call_points.text: Mahad contrast media backward integration to commission later this calendar year, ahead of earlier H2 guidance.
Hyderabad R&D center first phase expected operational this month.
PI intermediate supply restarted after destocking; performance expected to sustain for FY27 on order visibility.
Three contrast media candidates expected to launch in FY27; pilot activities for a new high-intensity sweetener.
QIP completed, strengthening balance sheet and providing financial flexibility.
Contrast media revenue recognition depends on goods reaching customer location; transit delays can defer sales.
Contrast media FY27 growth expected in double digits, helped by 1-2 validations and one commercial launch.
No FY27 margin guidance; management says Q1 cost structures will give a better picture.
PI/API destocking has ended; management expects to normalize and grow over the FY25 peak.
Three to four new contrast media product launches expected in FY27.
FY26 gross margin 54% vs 55%; rupee depreciation offset raw material inflation from the Iran war.
FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 31% from 37% on lower PI/API volumes.
Company ended FY26 debt-free with ₹400 Cr liquid financial assets and ₹334 Cr operating cash flow.
A customer's sole formulation plant received a USFDA warning letter in October; management sees no import alert or supply disruption yet.
Peptide intermediates may face faster price erosion than contrast media or patented CDMO products.
No fundraise decided; management says the situation is dynamic and it is accelerating capex from existing liquidity.

guidance.statement: Contrast media to grow in double digits in FY27, helped by 1-2 validations and one commercial launch.
FY27 capex of approximately ₹400 Cr towards Vizag, Mahad completion and Ambernath additions.
Expected capital expenditure for the next three years will be INR1,000-odd crores, with approximately INR250 crores in FY27.
guidance.target: ₹1,000-odd Cr over three years; ₹250 Cr in FY27

guidance.statement: Vizag Phase 1 investment of approximately INR1,000 crores over the next 3 years.

operating_notes.text: Contrast media FY26 revenue was ₹495 Cr, up 23% YoY, with Q4 at ₹193 Cr, up 91% YoY.
PI/API FY26 revenue fell 35% to ₹298 Cr on destocking of a cardiovascular intermediate; Q4 was ₹2.4 Cr.
Total CWIP at March 2026 was ₹301 Cr, mainly Mahad and Vizag land.
Contrast media plant utilisation steady at 70-odd percent; production to dispatches at 100%.
Mahad project has ₹210 Cr invested with ₹40 Cr more committed; total asset addition expected over ₹200 Cr on commissioning.
Approximately 70% of energy consumption sourced through renewable energy (wind and solar).

timeline.summary: On its 25 May 2026 Q4/FY26 earnings call, Blue Jet guided to about ₹1,000 Cr Vizag capex over three years and said FY26 revenue fell 8% to ₹947 Cr with EBITDA margin at 31%.
Blue Jet Q1FY27 earnings call: revenue ₹293 Cr, up 25% QoQ; EBITDA margin 33.5%; Mahad commissioning ahead of schedule; Vizag Phase 1 ₹1,000 Cr over three years.
